This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 5 [[great icosahedron|great icosahedra]], in the same arrangement as in the [[Compound of five icosahedra|compound of 5 icosahedra]].

Under the action of the symmetry group, the triangles in this compound decompose into two [[Orbit (group theory)|orbits]]: 40 of the triangles lie in coplanar pairs in icosahedral planes, while the other 60 lie in unique planes.
